map.抽签与随机排序：把名单随机重排，做公平抽取或随机展示。: Drawing and random ordering: randomly reorder a list for fair draws or random display.
map.抽样与练习：打乱题库顺序，避免按固定顺序作答。: Sampling and practice: shuffle a question bank so answers are not given in a fixed order.
map.A/B 展示：随机排列卡片顺序减少位置偏差。: A/B display: randomly arrange card order to reduce position bias.
map.粘贴 30 个名字，打乱后得到随机顺序，取前 5 个做中奖；如需可复现，记住种子: Paste 30 names, shuffle to a random order, take the first 5 as winners; for reproducibility, remember the seed or save this result to replay.
map.能复现同一次结果吗？: Can the same shuffle be reproduced?
map.基于洗牌，默认每次不同；若需可复现，记下种子或导出结果。公平抽奖建议公开种子防争: It is shuffle-based and differs each time by default; for reproducibility, note the seed or export the result. For fair lotteries, publish the seed to avoid disputes.
map.不去重，仅重排；如需唯一名单请先去重再打乱。: No deduplication, only reordering; for a unique list, deduplicate first, then shuffle.
